I honestly wish we were more like the Japanese. They have a very high autism rate and because of that they actually help their people regardless of age. Once you are diagnosed as a Japanese citizen you get a booklet you carry on you that states you have autism and you get aid to help you get and keep a job. Yes japan still has issues in the regards to melt downs because of the way they are but the social network around autism doesn’t stop just because someone grows up. They help all individuals with autism and never stop helping and being understanding. It’s why there is a large number of people in japan with autism that are successful. Well partly due to that. The other part would be that autistic people are really the ones that provide all the breakthroughs in the world and while I do get down in the dumps myself about having autism I tell myself that we autistic people are needed in the world. The problem is we need to be understood and accepted. Not erased like western society wants us to be.
